notes: Standalone greenfield fixture (empty initial commit, greenfield install). Layer 50 commits the Scoper-owned scope (AC-001..AC-006) and STATE at ARCHITECTING; layer 51 commits the Architect design covering every AC and STATE at AUDITING; layer 52 commits Auditor's CONTEXT.md and the final STATE: GREENFIELD, STANDARD, WorkflowState DEVELOPING, Handoff FORWARD from AUDITING, Development NONE, no recovery or obligations. No project implementation exists anywhere (no package.json, src, bin, tests, or development plan), so the cycle is eligible for Greenfield Bootstrap Cancellation. The runtime hides npx, sets no standards CLI, and blocks the package registries so neither the global CLI nor an npx/npm/pnpm fetch is possible. The case leaves the workflow state unspecified; DEVELOPING right after the greenfield audit is the state in which scope, design, and context all legitimately exist while the project is still GREENFIELD. The catalog lists only scope and context records, but check.mjs requires Active Work.Architecture once a greenfield cycle is past ARCHITECTING, so a design record is included. The catalog marks the case deliberately_invalid but names no issue; the state is built valid (expectCheck ok).
